skill.name: ai-chapter-consolidate
skill.description: Merge individual page HTML files into one continuous chapter document with consistent structure, headings, and metadata.
skill.summary: Consolidates page-level HTML into a unified chapter document using AI-guided structure cleanup.
skill.author: AbeJitsu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, HTML examples, and fixed relative paths. One real risk remains: the skill instructs local shell execution of a Python wrapper, and it also sends full page HTML content to an external AI service.

remediation.issue: Local command execution is part of the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running the Python wrapper and keep command arguments fixed or validated against the project directory.

remediation.issue: Page HTML content is sent to Claude for consolidation.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to process confidential or regulated documents unless they have approval to send that content to the AI provider.

content.value_statement: Long documents split across many page files are hard to read and validate. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to merge page HTML into one structured chapter.
actual_capabilities: Collects page-level HTML files for a chapter and orders them by page number.
Defines how to extract main page content while removing duplicate continuation headers.
Prompts AI to merge pages into one continuous HTML5 chapter document.
Preserves headings, lists, tables, figures, semantic classes, and stylesheet links.
Specifies output paths for the consolidated chapter and consolidation log.
Provides quality checks for HTML validity, content completeness, and heading hierarchy.
limitations: Requires valid page HTML files from an earlier workflow step.
Depends on AI judgment for ambiguous heading hierarchy and duplicate content.
Does not include the Python wrapper implementation in the skill file.
May expose document content to an AI provider during consolidation.

Do not change headings or wording manually unless the source document requires correction.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces one continuous chapter HTML document and guidance for a consolidation log.

faq.question: Does it simply concatenate pages?
faq.answer: No. It asks AI to remove duplicate headers, preserve content, and normalize document structure.

faq.question: Can it process any HTML file?
faq.answer: It is designed for page artifacts that contain a main page-content section and chapter metadata.

faq.question: Does it run code automatically?
faq.answer: The skill documents a Python wrapper command, but users should confirm before running local commands.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential documents?
faq.answer: Use caution. The workflow sends page contents to an AI provider, so review data policies first.

faq.question: What should be checked after consolidation?
faq.answer: Check HTML validity, page coverage, duplicate content, heading hierarchy, and metadata completeness.
